shared_elements: frontal standing anthropomorphic figure carved in the round on a columnar block
head crowned by a distinct upper element (headdress/helmet-like superstructure) above the face
schematic facial features (eyes, nose, mouth) rendered on a broad flat face
arms/hands brought around to the front of the torso
rounded boss or disc on the chest/belly area
incised linear details on the head/upper element
justification: Both depict a frontal, columnar anthropomorphic figure with a broad schematic face surmounted by a separate crowning element (headdress or toothed superstructure), arms folded onto the front of the torso and a rounded disc/boss on the chest, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme for a standing figure. The clearest difference is that B's crowning element is an explicit grinning, densely toothed mouth forming a second superimposed face, while A's upper element is a plain flaring headdress and A's torso carries incised geometric ornament (concentric circle, bands, hooks) absent in B.
